changes.title: Treehouse cooldown
items: Taking off from the treehouse no longer lands you straight back on the next branch: for 3 seconds after leaving a treehouse floor you fly on over its floors, and for 3 seconds after landing you can't take off or step off again

changes.title: Loading fade
items: The loading screen now fades out slowly onto her bedroom (about 2.5 seconds; a slider on the pause page), with her alarm going off as the room appears

changes.title: First hat floor
items: Your hat on the treehouse floor on your first morning shows again, lying on the floor where you can see it, even with you standing behind it

changes.title: Nightie first frame
items: On a fresh game the witch is in her nightie in bed from the moment the loading screen ends, no longer in her day clothes for a second or two first.

changes.title: Legend three icons
items: A legend on your leash shows three buff icons beside its sigil, as it gives three times the buff
Every leashed adult now shows its buff icon: gold when it's giving the buff, blue when another of its kind already is, and twinkling pink when it needs feeding

changes.title: Baby queue spacing
items: Babies following you keep their distance by size: a baby elephant or crocodile no longer squashes into the one in front
Big babies scatter a little further in a fight, so all of them are out of view
